title: Good app even if a bit expensive
body:
Fourth review : 
I
’m adding one star back to the app as the syncing problems seem to have gone away. The « forever plan » is still way to expensive in my opinion but it’s a now at least usable again.

——————————————————————————————————

Third review :

The app now only works on iPhone. The sync on Mac and Apple Watch is either incomplete ( some habits will show but not others) or inexistant (like on the Apple Watch where it just loads endlessly)   Removing one star again. I can’t decently recommend anyone this app even tho I’m a paid customer for 2 years. I’ll quit and switch to the competition as soon as my yearly plan ends. 

——————————————————————————————————

Second review :

I’m removing one star because syncing on the Mac does not seem to work anymore otherwise. I still love this app. 

——————————————————————————————————

First review :

I think it’s the best habit tracking and building app out there. It keeps me motivated and I already implemented several habits with it. I now do push ups every morning and I quit coffee for good. However, I have encountered some bugs on the Apple Watch version but nothing major. Support is very quick and helpful. The only downside really is price. I think 40 bucks is a bit much for an app this size. Maybe the price of the annual subscription should be the price of the app for ever. It would still be a lot but more manageable. For this price you have very complex apps like procreated and whatnot so I don’t really se the reasoning behind the high price. Anyway thanks a lot to the developers good job !

title: A great app, that’s effective, efficient and easy to use!
body:
Habitify is an app that you should download if you are looking to create some habits that will stick.
You can have multiple habits at once and you set the goal that you want (how many times a week). It reminds you to do your habit at the time that you set it to, so you don’t forget!
My experience so far has been excellent and I would definitely recommend you download it.

title: Great Design, Sync and Features
body:
Habitify is really a great App : sync works perfectly, design is very pleasant, and features are smart and useful. It’s not the kind of gadget you let after little use.

It’s a real pleasure to use it while improving the productivity.

For the price of the app, we expect more improvements : routines on a monthly basis, several times in the day, posibility to manage the statistics (on a monthly basis for example instead of…7 weeks), remarks to note for each routine…

Habitify has great potential and we hope good surprises in the coming updates.
